notes: Observation-only deployment. Enabling flags is commissioning, not automatic initialization.
Seven controller joint angles in degrees; no URDF mapping is assumed.
Reviewed joint envelope must cover the entire controller path and fixed scene, not just endpoints. This is not a collision planner.
Local file lock only excludes ASPIRE instances; it does not exclude pendant, teleoperation or other ROS clients.
Remote-agent disconnect, process kill and physical emergency-stop behaviour require on-site acceptance before autonomous use.
